name: Day log
use: read what was recorded on one pen, litter or task, grouped by day (Farrowing log, pen log, the walk log)
notUse: a log that mixes kinds of event with a kind filter (use Categorised) or an editable record (use Row)
states: One entry for a run of acts

name: Categorised
use: a log that mixes kinds of event (Health, Feed, Movement, Notes) and can be filtered by kind and date: the pig log and the pen log on a walk
notUse: a log of one kind of act (use Day log); the kind word is one word, never a sentence
